_about: Off-the-shelf actuators we can buy (RobStride QDD modules). Torque, no-load speed (200 rpm = 20.9 rad/s, each +-10 %), mass and gear from RobStride's Product_Information spec table of 2026-07-13 (github.com/RobStride/Product_Information). RS04's 40 N m rating is at 50 rpm on a 345 x 345 mm aluminium heat sink (35 N m on 220 x 200 mm): echo's mounts are smaller, so expect less. Sizes from retailer listings: confirm against the vendor's STEP before ordering. 'r' is half the square flange size, 'h' the length along the output axis. 'ratio' > 1 means an extra linkage reduction after the module (torque x ratio, speed / ratio). Joint dynamics (tools/make_robot_files.py; 2026-10-31 ESTIMATES: RobStride publishes no rotor inertia in its spec tables; K-Bot's MJCF uses 0.005 / 0.0015 / 0.005 / 0.007 kg m2 armature on RS00 / 02 / 03 / 04, tuned values up to 5 x from ours): 'gear' the module's reduction, 'rotor_kgm2' the motor rotor's inertia, scaled from the frame size against Unitree's 7520 motor (5e-5 kg m2, from G1's armature 0.0102 at 14.3:1); reflected at the output as armature = rotor x gear^2; 'damping_nms' viscous and 'friction_nm' Coulomb friction at the output, typical of QDD modules (friction about 2-3 % of peak torque).
